recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel graphic layout featuring a large header, two distinct album cover representations side-by-side, and a footer title, utilizing a muted earth-tone palette and heavy mid-century sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale display text dominates the upper third against a dark textured background.
Two square-format inset images create a central horizontal axis.
A clean white footer provides high contrast for secondary descriptive text.
Horizontal rule lines separate the three primary vertical zones.
coreInvariants: Muted olive and brown color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large display text at top (100% width), two album thumbnails in the center (45% width each), and centered text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized, mustard-yellow display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow, scanning left-to-right across the central album panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the bottom third to balance the dense, dark upper two-thirds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep chocolate brown background for the top and middle sections.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/cream for the bottom section and inset borders.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard yellow for primary display text and thin decorative rules.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the dark brown and light cream areas.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with geometric foundations.
characterSpecificRedesigns: J with a hook that extends below the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold uppercase sans-serif for impact paired with a softer, slanted sans-serif for descriptive details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the main header.
Captures the mid-century vibe for the footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tiered layout. Top tier is a textured dark brown rectangle with a thin mustard line at the bottom. Middle tier is a dark brown section containing two square photo placeholders side-by-side. Bottom tier is a solid cream-white rectangle separated by a thick dark brown line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large mustard-yellow condensed sans-serif text in the top tier. Add two lines of dark brown bold italic sans-serif text centered in the bottom cream tier.

verificationChecks: Is the top text significantly larger than the bottom text?
Are the two central images perfectly square?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones?
Are there clear horizontal dividers between sections?

adjustableVariables: Spacing between the two central image panels
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern sans-serifs like Helvetica are used; prefer older grotesques.
Check that the halftone texture is visible in the dark areas.
Verify the mustard yellow is not too bright or 'neon'.
Confirm the layout follows a strict top-middle-bottom hierarchy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a heavy condensed sans-serif header on a dark textured ground with a modular image grid and a high-contrast white footer for a classic retrospective look.
